from fwmigrate.extraction.models import ExtractionResult
from .source_model import PANScope, PANSourceObject
from .resolver import PANResolver
from .xml_utils import text_or_none, member_texts

class PANOSSourceParser(BaseSourceParser):
    """Parses Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS XML configuration exports into canonical IRConfig."""

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.resolver = PANResolver()

def _parse_to_ir(self, content: str, zone_mapping: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None) -> IRConfig:
        try:
            root = ET.fromstring(content)
        except ET.ParseError:
            cleaned = content.strip()
            root = ET.fromstring(cleaned)

        # 1. Metadata
        hostname = "palo-alto-fw"
        host_elem = root.find(".//system/hostname")
        if host_elem is None:
            host_elem = root.find(".//deviceconfig/system/hostname")
        if host_elem is not None and host_elem.text:
            hostname = host_elem.text.strip()

        ir = IRConfig(
            metadata=IRMetadata(
                hostname=hostname,
                source_vendor="palo_alto"
            )
        )

        # Basic Scoped Traversal
        # For Phase 03: we introduce the scopes. Panorama & VSYS loop will be fully built out in later phases.
        # Currently we handle 'shared' (root) and single 'vsys' gracefully.
        
        shared_scope = PANScope(kind="shared", name="shared")
        self._parse_scope(shared_scope, root, ir)

        for vsys_entry in root.findall(".//vsys/entry"):
            v_name = vsys_entry.get("name") or "vsys1"
            vsys_scope = PANScope(kind="vsys", name=v_name, vsys=v_name)
            self._parse_scope(vsys_scope, vsys_entry, ir)

        return ir

    def _parse_scope(self, scope: PANScope, search_root: ET.Element, ir: IRConfig):
        self._parse_zones(scope, search_root, ir)
        self._parse_addresses(scope, search_root, ir)
        self._parse_address_groups(scope, search_root, ir)
        self._parse_services(scope, search_root, ir)
        self._parse_service_groups(scope, search_root, ir)
        self._parse_security_profile_groups(scope, search_root, ir)
        self._parse_policies(scope, search_root, ir)
        self._parse_nat_rules(scope, search_root, ir)
        self._parse_routes(scope, search_root, ir)
